user.title: Camera Timeline
user.description: Keeps a timeline of what your cameras saw: a picture on a schedule, a burst at every motion, person or doorbell event, and what you ask for in between.

data.quiet_cameras: Only at events and when asked

data_description.cameras: The cameras to keep a timeline of.
data_description.stream_cameras: Battery cameras whose snapshot is only as fresh as their last wake. Cameras from eufy-sdk are captured from their stream already.
data_description.interval: How often to take a picture of each camera, in seconds. 0 keeps only events and what you ask for.
data_description.keep_hours: How long pictures and recordings are kept.
data_description.quiet_cameras: Never pictured on the schedule: battery doorbells and cameras whose own motion sensor trips when they're woken.

snapshot.name: Snapshot
snapshot.description: Take a picture now, or a burst of five, keep it on the timeline and answer with it as base64 JPEG.

burst.name: Burst
burst.description: Five frames half a second apart, to tell movement from stillness.

get_frames.name: Get frames
get_frames.description: What a camera saw: the newest pictures, or every picture in a window, newest first, with why each was taken and which event it caught.

wakes.name: Wakes
wakes.description: How many of the newest captures, when no window is given.

frames.name: Frames per capture
frames.description: Frames from the middle of each capture; 0 for all.

minutes.name: Minutes
minutes.description: Every capture in the last this many minutes.

until.name: Until
until.description: Every capture up to this time.

most.name: Most
most.description: At most this many captures, evenly spread; with a window the answer also lists every capture's time.

events_only.name: Events only
events_only.description: Only captures that caught an event.

wait.name: Wait
wait.description: If a capture is being taken, wait for it.

get_events.name: Get events
get_events.description: The motion, person, pet and doorbell events the timeline caught, newest first.

entity_id.name: Camera
entity_id.description: One camera, or leave empty for all.
